profiles.name: Download and Use
profiles.summary: Use BusinessOS directly from one local folder with no Git, hosted service, or external workspace required.

profiles.name: Private Versioned Workspace
profiles.summary: Keep the BusinessOS product separate from an organization-owned workspace and optionally version that workspace with private Git.

profiles.name: Shared Organization Workspace
profiles.summary: Separate canonical BusinessOS product files from a private team-owned state/knowledge workspace with controlled Git collaboration or equivalent organization infrastructure.

invariant: All profiles use the same BusinessOS contracts and files. Git, Obsidian, hosted services, and external workspaces are optional deployment adapters, not required runtime dependencies.
